title: An open-plan family home
intro: Living, dining and a sculptural staircase share one generous volume. Timber-toned surfaces and blue accents connect the spaces, while a suspended seat brings another place to pause.
detail: The room sequence moves from social spaces into quieter bedrooms. Geometric wall treatments, built-in storage and layered lighting give each room its own character within the home.

gallery.caption: Wide living-room view with a sectional, television wall, staircase and suspended bench above a planted pebble bed.
materials: Wood-look stair trim and ceiling ring

title: A home in teal and timber
intro: A teal kitchen, timber-toned details and softly curved forms run through the living and dining spaces. The pooja enclosure sits within this shared composition, with its own more intricate architectural language.
detail: The bedrooms introduce two different moods: botanical green in the guest room, and warm stone-look textures in the main bedroom. Storage is woven into the walls rather than treated as a separate element.

gallery.caption: Long open-plan view linking a cream sofa and TV wall to the dining table and kitchen beyond.

title: A nail studio in sage and blush
intro: Illuminated polish displays form the backdrop to the manicure stations. A compact reception, organised work surfaces and individual pedicure seats give the small studio a clear rhythm.
detail: Two palette studies explore the same interior: muted sage with pale surfaces, and a softer blush version. The shelving, arches and restrained lighting remain the connecting elements.

title: Workspaces in green and graphite
intro: Curved green seating sits against a more precise language of glazing, dark grids and timber-toned furniture. Reception, workstations and meeting rooms carry these contrasts through the office studies.
detail: The collection explores both lighter and darker schemes. Shared desks, enclosed meeting areas and smaller seating groups offer different scales of interaction within the workspace.

title: Reception and places to meet
intro: A curved reception counter introduces a collection of waiting areas, executive cabins and meeting spaces. Pale finishes and blue accents give the arrival spaces a calm visual centre.
detail: Glazed divisions, planted corners and varied seating arrangements appear throughout the studies. The gallery follows the progression from reception to more private working and meeting spaces.

title: A blue bedroom with botanical details
intro: A blue upholstered bed and bench sit alongside botanical-pattern panels, rounded cabinetry and full-height curtains. The colour is concentrated around the bed, with quieter surfaces around it.
detail: A dressing table, slim television console and integrated storage extend the design beyond the main view. Supporting angles show how these elements meet the window and the room's corners.

detail: The collection considers different room arrangements, with blue and teal accents alongside quieter neutral finishes.
